title: 30A East Seagrove Shores Santa Rosa Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beachside Retreat!* Just a 2-Minute Walk to the Beach* Community Pool* Prime Seagrove Beach Location* Close to the Best of 30A's...
description_expanded: OverviewTop Reasons to Book this Fabulous Beachside Retreat!* Just a 2-Minute Walk to the Beach* Community Pool* Prime Seagrove Beach Location* Close to the Best of 30A's Beaches, Dining and Attractions* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Seagrove Shores is a bright and inviting one-bedroom, two-bathroom beach retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Perfect for couples or small families, this comfortable getaway offers a spacious living area, private balcony, and an unbeatable location just a short walk from the sugar-white sands. After a relaxing day at the beach, unwind on the balcony or settle into the comfortable living area. The fully equipped kitchen makes it easy to prepare everything from a quick breakfast to a relaxing dinner at home. The master bedroom features a comfortable king bed, while a sleeper sofa in the living area provides additional sleeping space for up to four guests. Seagrove Shores offers the convenience and comfort you need for a carefree beach vacation.Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedLiving Room: Sofa BedSmart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance by guests and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, decibel meters, and video surveillance, including the front door.Area Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
